promptText: What tool matches this description: "Get more work done with AI agents that work side by side with your people. Execute, manage, and operate together on one AI work platform to drive business results."?
rawText:
This description matches **ClickUp** (specifically promoting **ClickUp Brain** and its AI Work Platform). 

ClickUp uses this branding to highlight its shift into an all-in-one AI work platform where human teams and AI agents collaborate on project execution, task management, and business operations.
